partners_intro: We partner with reputable HR consulting firms to provide our clients with the most up-to-date approaches and comprehensive solutions. Our solutions are based on the most up-to-date HR practices and are tailored to your business.
text1: We're collaborating with DNLA GmbH on the implementation of the DNLA Expert System, a tool for analyzing potential and evaluating organizational performance.
text2: We work with SOLVE-X when it comes to using IT to help with HR processes.
text3: We cooperate with MM Consulting on reward system redesign and implementation, as well as work systematization and reorganization.
text4: We are working with Energos to redesign business models and optimise HR processes.
text5: Inspire4future is a digital solution that we created in collaboration with our partners. It enables organizations and individuals to assess their ability to successfully transition to future business in a professional and multi-dimensional manner.
